title: Runtime 429 exhaustion hard-excludes a lane after its cooldown has expired
wanted_capability: After a runtime rate-limit observation's cooldown expires, allocation should permit a fresh attempt with quota treated as unknown, while retaining the historical observation and respecting authoritative quota probes, credentials and other admission checks.
fallback_used: Direct credential-safe HTTP probe to distinguish current provider response from cached allocator exclusion.
evidence: live bro_allocator_status preview glm-5.3-flash: quota_exhausted with cooldown_active false and runtime_rate_limit confidence
src/orchestration/allocator.rs: score_candidate excludes Exhausted before checking cooldown
src/orchestration/account_probes.rs: record_disruption_cooldown marks runtime 429 as Exhausted
notes: A fresh direct Flash request still returned 429/code1308 at 21:46:50Z. This gap describes the independent stale admission latch, not evidence that upstream quota has reset.
resolution_note: Fixed in ffa5c8c8/b4f47d43, integrated and deployed at b015e051. Expired runtime cooldown permits fresh allocation with unknown capacity; historical receipt retained and summary marks expiry. Authoritative quota-probe exhaustion and credential failures still gate. Full suite 6687 passed; 165 isolated MCP checks include expiry and authoritative refusal. Live deployed preview selected glm-5.3-flash from previously stuck lane. Real bro_exec d52fa41b-fe00-48ab-9991-0ddf37a4b922 reached provider and failed in 5s with fresh HTTP429/code1308 at approximately22:14:49Z, proving admission recovery while upstream quota remains capped.
